verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms Figma serves a live llms.txt at developers.figma.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing its developer platform docs, which an agent can point to directly, and Figma also publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec on GitHub for programmatic doc consumption. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents successfully consume llms.txt in practice, and no dedicated agent-oriented docs page beyond the general llms.txt file.
